items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Now, the greatest hit in the show in the first half was the three Eddies. That was Tiny, Shaky, and Chick. Well these three fellows had been named the Three Eddies by Eddie Cantor.

ctx.x: show -- we started off with something like a plantation melody. I think it was a -- "My Old Kentucky Home". And then this mammy comes on and then Old "Strut" Payne comes on and they start singing. And Lyons, I must say, he built a beautiful picture. You know, like on a plantation, how they have lights and all that they have. I must say, they were very clever, between those Russians and all. And with the Germans that understood their business. Well I had never seen anything like that. It was really something out…

Now, the greatest hit in the show in the first half was the three Eddies. That was Tiny, Shaky, and Chick. Well these three fellows had been named the Three Eddies by Eddie Cantor. And he gave them -- they put on cork, and then they had these white glasses. You know these shorter rim white glasses that you use.*
